evaluation.design: Train 2010–2023 excluding 15% of properties. Select on Jan–Jun 2024. Calibrate on Jul–Dec 2024. Test on 2025. Refit through 2025 for website.
evaluation.caveat: Retrospective revised-data assessment. Type/area HPI for the target month is an observed market input. This does not test a real-time forecast before that index was published.

geography_note: Core markets and surrounding postal areas are separate. Linslade uses explicit locality labels plus 201 postcodes whose current centroids fall in Leighton-Linslade West ward (E05014416). This is a stated ward proxy, not an exact house boundary. Unresolved and other Leighton Buzzard postcodes remain broader comparison context.
